dialog.breakpoint.valueFilterHint: The value, then an optional mask — written =$03/$0F in the breakpoint's key. Leave the mask empty to compare every bit.
dialog.breakpoint.copperIndexHint: Accepts $00B, 11 or %1011 ($000-$3FF). A WAIT stops when it is satisfied; a MOVE when it is issued.
dialog.breakpoint.addressHintBank: Accepts $8000, 32768 or %1000000000000000 — or 05:+$0100 for an offset inside a 16K bank, wherever that bank is paged.

dialog.breakpoint.portMaskHint: Leave empty to match the port exactly.
dialog.breakpoint.messageHint: Logs to the Log pane and continues. {expr} or {exprHex} fills in a value; a leading [GROUP] names its group.
dialog.breakpoint.conditionHint: {action, select, log {Logs} other {Stops}} only when true. Registers, flags (ZF, CF, …), memory ([HL], w[$5C3A]), {operands, select, copper {VAL (the instruction word) and ADDR (the list index), } sprite {VAL (the byte written) and ADDR (the attribute byte, 0-4), } valAddr {VAL and ADDR, } other {}}labels.
dialog.breakpoint.hitCountHint: Counts the hits where the condition is true.
dialog.breakpoint.nextRegStopNote: Stops after the instruction that wrote the register, reporting its previous and new values.
dialog.breakpoint.copperStopNote: Stops after the Z80 instruction during which the Copper completed it. The Copper keeps running to the end of that instruction, so its PC may already be past the index.
dialog.breakpoint.spriteStopNote: Stops after the instruction during which the byte was written — through port $57 (by the CPU or the DMA) or the $35-$39/$75-$79 NextReg mirrors (by the CPU or the Copper) — reporting its previous and new values.
